reopen-after-kill.says: A pod whose app was stopped without closing it (a crash, a killed process or a power cut after the import) is opened again and answers its first question: the import had built the pod's database before it was stopped, so the first question is answered from it; no build was kept, so the next step builds the pod again from every file it holds.
reopen-after-kill.total: Opening a pod that was stopped before it closed and answering its first read: what a person waits for after the app was stopped without closing the pod.
